# SwillFam

> SwillFam is a Jakarta hospitality group founded in 2018, running seven lifestyle and nightlife venues in SCBD and Senopati, South Jakarta: Kilo Kitchen Jakarta, Kilo Cafe Jakarta, Dualism, Truce, ZOO SCBD, Le Cirque and The Swillhouse.

Key facts:
- Head office: Fairgrounds, SCBD Lot 14, Jl. Jenderal Sudirman Kav. 52-53, Senayan, Kebayoran Baru, Jakarta Selatan 12190
- Reservations and enquiries: WhatsApp +62 812 3352 4214 (each venue page also lists its own reservation WhatsApp)
- Email: crm.group@swillmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/swillfam

## Lifestyle venues (restaurant, café and bars)

- [Kilo Kitchen Jakarta](https://swillfam.com/venues/kilo-jakarta): Restaurant and bar at Ashta District 8, Senopati. Refined comfort food with Latin and Asian roots; casual and vibrant, where food, music and culture come together. Open daily from 09:00 or 10:00.
- [Kilo Cafe Jakarta](https://swillfam.com/venues/kilo-cafe): Café at Trinity Courts, SCBD, serving Kilo's comfort food. A day-to-night hangout beside the courts, from 16:00.
- [Dualism](https://swillfam.com/venues/dualism): Cocktail bar at SOL Collective Space, SCBD, where every signature drink comes in two expressions: same ingredients, two styles.
- [Truce](https://swillfam.com/venues/truce): Craft cocktail bar at Fairgrounds, SCBD, drawing on Japanese bar philosophy: balance, restraint and quiet precision.

## Nightlife venues (clubs)

- [ZOO SCBD](https://swillfam.com/venues/zoo): Nightclub at Fairgrounds, SCBD, with safari-meets-futuristic interiors; Amapiano, Afrobeats and global electronic sounds. Private rooms open daily.
- [Le Cirque](https://swillfam.com/venues/le-cirque): Club at Fairgrounds, SCBD, for music lovers, tastemakers and creatives; immersive experiences and forward-thinking sounds.
- [The Swillhouse](https://swillfam.com/venues/swillhouse): Club at Fairgrounds, SCBD, anchoring Jakarta's hip-hop and R&B scene since 2018; raw concrete and neon minimalism.
